title: [ingest] autosummary_ignore_module_all defaults to True (ignore __all__ in autosummary)
summary: `autosummary_ignore_module_all` defaults to `True`, meaning autosummary ignores a module's `__all__` and lists all discovered members. Setting it to `False` causes autosummary to respect `__all__` and only document explicitly exported names. Counter-intuitive name: "ignore" means the default behavior ignores `__all__`.
